scenario: A crop insurance adjuster receives a corn farmer's multi-year yield history (10 years of per-acre bushel records) and a current-year loss report. The adjuster uses csv-pipeline to compute the farmer's Actual Production History (APH) average yield, uses financial-calculator to compute the federal MPCI indemnity payment (coverage shortfall × coverage level × price election × insured acres), and uses afrexai-insurance-claims to produce the final adjudicated claim settlement.
info_flow: csv-pipeline reads the 10-year yield CSV and computes the APH average yield → financial-calculator computes the indemnity amount using the APH average, actual yield, coverage level, price election, and insured acres → afrexai-insurance-claims adjudicates the claim and issues the settlement recommendation.
